name: lazy refill caps capacity and preserves state under clock skew
input: a bucket with 42 tokens, then a backwards timestamp
test:
bucket = TokenBucket(tokens=42.0, last_refill_time=200.0, capacity=90, refill_rate=8.0)
updated = refill_token_bucket(bucket, 201.0)
assert updated.tokens == 50.0
assert updated.last_refill_time == 201.0
assert refill_token_bucket(TokenBucket(tokens=50.0, last_refill_time=201.0, capacity=90, refill_rate=8.0), 300.0).tokens == 90
skewed = refill_token_bucket(updated, 199.0)
assert skewed.tokens == 50.0
assert skewed.last_refill_time == 201.0
